data.long_description:
Provident is delighted to offer this well-maintained one-bedroom apartment located on a high floor of the prestigious DAMAC Heights (DAMAC Residence) in Dubai Marina. Featuring stunning sea and marina views, this home combines luxury, comfort, and convenience in one of Dubai’s most sought-after waterfront communities.

Property Details:

1 Bedroom
Fully Furnished
Vacant and Ready to Move In
High Floor
Balcony with Sea and Marina Views
Modern Kitchen and Living Area
1 Covered Parking Space
Well-Maintained Condition

Building Amenities:

State-of-the-art Gymnasium
Swimming Pool
24/7 Security and Concierge Service
High-Speed Elevators
Elegant Lobby and Common Areas

About DAMAC Heights:

Formerly known as DAMAC Residence, this 85-storey supertall tower stands at 335 meters and offers residents panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf and Palm Jumeirah. Developed by DAMAC Properties and designed by Aedas, the tower exemplifies luxury waterfront living.

About Dubai Marina:

Dubai Marina is one of the city’s most desirable neighborhoods, known for its vibrant waterfront lifestyle, iconic skyline, and 3 km man-made canal lined with upscale dining, retail, and leisure options — the perfect destination for modern city living.
